heading: Thursday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. A rising chance of showers in far northern New York, and near the Vermont/Québec border; chance late, down to around Route 2. Patchy fog. Lows from the upper 50s to mid 60s. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly cloudy north, with showers likely. Partly to mostly cloudy south, with a rising chance of showers, except slight chance in southeastern valleys. Highs in the mid to upper 60s north, and upper 60s to mid 70s in the south. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming northwest in the afternoon.

heading: Friday Night
text: Any evening showers tapering off, then gradual clearing from north to south. Lows from the mid 40s to around 50, some lower 40s northeast and in the Adirondacks. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.
